description: Baseline permissions for the main window. Deliberately small: PandaSpy handles printer access codes, so every entry needs a reason. `core:default` is Tauri's baseline. `autostart:default` lets the settings UI toggle launch-at-login over IPC — it stays OFF until the user opts in (Rust never calls enable()); this only grants the toggle. `notification:default` lets the app raise OS notifications for print events. single-instance and positioner are intentionally absent: both are driven entirely from Rust (second-launch focus, tray-anchored window moves) and expose nothing over IPC, so they need no capability here — a later milestone that calls them from the frontend adds the permission in that change.
